# 3d-soft-emboss

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Neumorphic soft-embossed grey devices: jigsaw ring, segment ring or overlapping circles pressed into a matte grey field. Backdrop: Matte light grey. Items: 3 to 6. Default aspect: landscape.

## Colour palette

- Monochrome: field and shapes #E6E8EB, highlight shadow white at 80 percent, low shadow #B9BEC5, icons and text #4A4F57
- A brand colour override tints only the icons and item names; shapes stay grey

## Visual elements

- Ring device 55 to 70 percent of the canvas height, edge shadows 3 to 5 percent of its diameter
- Grooves between pieces as thin dark-then-light shadow pairs
- Icon discs raised, 14 to 18 percent of the device diameter, flat dark icons
- Text cards raised the same way, aligned in one column
- Matte finish everywhere; no gloss highlights

## Typography

- Family typography; numerals thin and large in light grey, names bold caps dark grey, body light grey

## Composition rules

- Landscape: device right, cards left (ref 01) or device centred with items either side (ref 02)
- Three items: segment ring or overlapping circles; four items: jigsaw or segment ring
- {'Five or six items': 'chevron row, landscape only'}
- More than six items, switch to 3d-paper-tile or 3d-capsule-hub

## Layout

### Structure

- One ring device 55 to 70 percent of the canvas height, on the right or centred
- Jigsaw ring: a disc cut into three or four puzzle pieces with knob-and-socket edges, one icon disc per piece
- Segment ring: a disc cut into three or four wedges by thin grooves, one icon disc per wedge
- Overlapping circles: three translucent circles overlapping like a Venn, numerals in the overlaps, icon disc on each outer lobe
- Numbered text cards or big numerals in a column beside the device, one per item
- {'Chevron row': 'five or six raised chevron arrows nesting left to right in one row, numeral and name on each, a raised icon disc with a caption under each chevron'}

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual Emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Jigsaw ring** | Parts that lock into one whole | Puzzle-cut disc, pieces separated by fine grooves |
| **Segment ring** | Cycles and phases | Wedge-cut disc around a recessed centre |
| **Overlapping circles** | Shared ground between three areas | Three raised circles with numerals in the overlaps |
| **Chevron row** | Sequences of five or six steps | Raised chevrons in a row, icon discs and captions beneath, title between thin rules |

### Visual Elements

- Every shape is the same light grey as the backdrop, raised by a soft light-top-left shadow and a darker bottom-right shadow
- Icon discs raised a second level above the piece, dark grey flat icons
- Recessed centre disc on the ring devices
- Text cards: raised rounded rectangles with a large light-grey numeral and dark text
- No colour, no outlines, no gloss; depth comes from shadow only

### Text Placement

- Title centred at top between two thin rules
- Item numerals 01 to 04 large and light grey on the cards or beside the device
- Item name bold caps in dark grey, description light grey below
- No text on the device except numerals in the overlaps

## Best for

- Three or four part frameworks
- Cycles with few phases
- Shared responsibilities and overlaps
- Understated monochrome decks
